description: TimeSplitters: Future Perfect (GameCube release, played through Dolphin).

1.0.0.description:
# TimeSplitters: Future Perfect Archipelago 1.0.0

First release of the Archipelago randomizer for TimeSplitters: Future Perfect (GameCube, USA), played in Dolphin.

## Features

- **Everything is a check**: story mission clears on each difficulty, mission objectives, Challenge and Arcade League medals (Bronze to Platinum), and optionally every health and armour pickup in the story.
- **Play the modes you want**: any mix of Story, Arcade League and Challenges. With Story, the goal is to clear Future Perfect once enough Time Crystals arrive; without it, the goal is a share of the medals.
- **Weapon Gating**: weapons are items, and a gun you have not received is taken away.
- **Weapon Shuffle**: each weapon is replaced by another in the story, everywhere at once, by class, or only among a level's own guns. Grenades and mines only swap among themselves, and a shuffled-in gun's ammo scales to its own capacity.
- **Health and armour pickups as checks**, including the ones inside cabinets, boxes and safes. The Temporal Uplink collects them even at full health.
- **Skip Intro Cutscenes** (on by default): missions start straight away. The cutscenes still unlock in the gallery.
- **Mouse look built in**, including turrets, tanks and security cameras.
- **One Launcher entry**: the client patches a copy of your disc, starts Dolphin, starts mouse look and connects.
- **One profile per seed**: create a new profile for each seed and the client registers it, so progress from other profiles is never sent by mistake.

## Requirements

- Archipelago 0.6.4 or newer
- Dolphin
- Your own legally obtained copy of TimeSplitters: Future Perfect (USA) disc image (`G3FE69`) as ISO, GCM or CISO. Convert RVZ to ISO in Dolphin first.
- Windows for mouse look

## Install

Download `timesplittersfp.apworld` below and double-click it, or copy it into Archipelago's `custom_worlds` folder. Make your yaml with **Generate Template Options** in the Launcher, then open **TimeSplitters FP Client** from the Launcher. It asks for Dolphin and your disc image the first time. See the README for the full walkthrough.

## Notes

- Create a new profile in the game for each seed.
- Keep Dolphin cheat codes (Gecko / Action Replay) off for this game.
- If the game or the client crashes, close both and start the client again.

## Known issues

- Guns mounted on vehicles aim up and down slowly with the mouse.
- In The Khallos Express, the health pack in the safe only appears if you let Harry Tipper open it. Flipping the switch in the room too quickly stops Harry from opening the safe, which means it never spawns until the mission is restarted.

1.0.1.description:
# TimeSplitters: Future Perfect Archipelago 1.0.1

## New: traps

A new **Trap Count** option (8 by default) puts traps in place of filler. Each one switches on one of the game's cheats for 30 seconds in the middle of a story mission: Big Head, Small Head, Big Hands, Fat, Rotating Heads, Cardboard Enemies, Slow Death, Old Film, 8-Bit or Cascade. They go off one at a time, and a trap received outside a story mission waits for the next one. Traps never go off in Arcade or Challenges, and a seed without Story has none.

## New: music shuffle and your own songs

Set `music_shuffle` under `timesplittersfp_options` in `host.yaml`:

- `game_music`: the level and menu music is shuffled.
- `game_and_custom`: your songs join the game's, and every level and menu track is picked from both.
- `custom_only`: as many of your songs as fit replace game tracks, shuffled in with the rest.

**Using your own songs needs ffmpeg**, a free audio tool. Install it once, then restart the Archipelago Launcher:

- Windows 10/11: `winget install Gyan.FFmpeg`
- macOS: `brew install ffmpeg` (needs [Homebrew](https://brew.sh), which isn't installed by default)
- Linux: your package manager, e.g. `sudo apt install ffmpeg`
- Or download it from ffmpeg.org and set `ffmpeg_path` in `host.yaml`.

Then put your songs in a folder (or a .zip), in any common format. The client asks for the folder the first time, and converts and volume-matches each song once. Songs in an `events` subfolder become the mission-complete and challenge-won stingers. Music is shuffled again every launch; set `music_seed` to keep a shuffle you like. Cutscene music is never changed.

The client window opens straight away and shows its progress while it prepares your disc copy, and songs convert several at a time, so even a large folder only takes a few minutes the first time.

## New: voices in French, German, Italian or Spanish

Own a European copy of the game in another language? Set `voice_disc` in `host.yaml` to that disc image, and its voices play in the randomizer, both in levels and in cutscenes. Any format Dolphin reads works. Menus and subtitles stay in English. With a voice disc set, the patched copy is written as a plain ISO.

Your original discs are never changed.

## Fixes

- Enemies now fire shuffled guns at the right pace: a Dispersion Gun in the machine gun's place is no longer sprayed like a machine gun, standing or from cover.
1.0.1.title: TSFP-AP v1.0.1

1.0.2.description:
# TimeSplitters: Future Perfect Archipelago 1.0.2

A Weapon Shuffle fix release. Only the client and the disc patch changed: options, items and locations are the same as 1.0.1, so games already in progress can update straight away.

## Fixes

- **No more crash when an enemy fires a shuffled-in Rocket Launcher.** A level only loaded the rockets and grenades of the guns it normally has, so a Rocket Launcher shuffled in somewhere else fired a rocket that wasn't there, and Dolphin stopped with "Unable to resolve write address". Levels now load the projectiles of every shuffled-in gun, in every story mission, not only the first one played.
- **Shuffled guns get the right ammo from pickups.** A shuffled-in gun still runs on the ammo of the gun it replaces, sized to its own capacity, but the game now scales each pickup itself. Pickups count straight away, are no longer cut short by the old gun's maximum, and dual-wield pickups double correctly.
- **A shuffled Pistol uses its new slot's ammo** instead of keeping the Pistol's own.
- **The HUD shows the shuffled-in gun's own ammo.** An SBP500 in the Injector's place now shows bullets, not darts. Ammo boxes on the floor still look like the replaced gun's ammo, and still fill the gun.
- **Attachments follow the shuffled-in gun.** A shuffled-in LX-18 can equip its silencer again, and a gun without attachments no longer shows the scroll-up arrows.

## Docs

- The README has example paths for `music_folder`, `ffmpeg_path` and `voice_disc`, and a sample song folder. Use forward slashes in `host.yaml`: a backslash inside the quotes breaks the file.

## Upgrading

Replace `timesplittersfp.apworld` in your Archipelago `custom_worlds` folder and restart the Launcher. The client updates your patched disc copy the next time it starts. Your original disc is never changed.
1.0.2.title: TSFP-AP v1.0.2

1.0.3.description:
# TimeSplitters: Future Perfect Archipelago 1.0.3

Crash fixes for Weapon Shuffle, plus a few client fixes. Only the client and the disc patch changed: options, items and locations are the same as 1.0.2, so games already in progress can update straight away.

## Crash fixes

- **No more crash when you kill a guard carrying a shuffled-in gun in the Harpoon Gun's or Injector's place** (seen in You Take the High Road). The dropped gun used a harpoon or dart model the level never loaded.
- **No more crash when weapon gating takes away a gun you just picked up** (seen in Scotland the Brave with a second Minigun). Gating no longer switches you to grenades or mines: it picks one of your guns, or bare hands.

## Fixes

- **Guards shoot again.** Since 1.0.2, guards whose gun borrows another gun's ammo could end up with none and come at you with their fists.
- **Dropped guns look like themselves.** A guard's shuffled-in gun no longer drops looking like a harpoon or a dart.
- **No bogus checks after a crash.** If the game crashes but Dolphin stays open, the client now sees the game as lost and stops, instead of reading garbage and sending checks you never made.
- **Your profile is recognised after a restart.** Restarting the client and Dolphin on the same seed no longer asks for `/use_profile` on the profile you were already playing.

## Upgrading

Replace `timesplittersfp.apworld` in your Archipelago `custom_worlds` folder and restart the Launcher. The client updates your patched disc copy the next time it starts. Your original disc is never changed.
1.0.3.title: TSFP-AP v1.0.3

1.0.4.description:
# TimeSplitters: Future Perfect Archipelago 1.0.4

Fixes for missed checks, a black screen after some missions, and generation, plus two logic changes.

## Fixes

- **No more black screen after Machine Wars, Mansion of Madness or The Russian Connection.** Missions without an ending cutscene returned to an invisible menu, and pressing a button restarted the mission. The menu now comes back normally.
- **Container and safe health/armour checks send again.** Packs that drop out of a container or safe (such as the safe in The Khallos Express) were never counted. Any pack taken that isn't a check is now noted in the client log.
- **Level clears have a backup.** If the game's own clear is missed, finishing a level's last objective now sends the clear for the difficulty you played (and the easier ones). Mansion of Madness, You Take the High Road and Future Perfect still rely on the game's own clear.
- **Spent harpoons and darts refill the gun that fired them.** With the Harpoon Gun or Injector shuffled into another gun's place, bolts picked up from walls now give that gun its ammo instead of nothing.
- **Challenges and Arcade stay locked when the client isn't connected.** Playing without the client used to unlock matches the normal way, and those medals were sent as checks once the client connected. The patched game now keeps every match locked until the client opens what your seed has granted.
- **Story-only seeds with Weapon Gating generate reliably.** About half of them used to fail, because the random starting mission could leave almost nothing to check. Generation now redraws the starting missions until at least 5 checks are open.

## Logic

- **Protect Harry Tipper** (The Russian Connection) and everything after it need a ranged gun: not an explosive, flamethrower, shotgun-style gun, Flare Gun, Injector or Harpoon Gun.
- **Machine Wars** needs the same kind of ranged gun for everything after Health 3.
- **Scotland the Brave:** Infiltrate the castle and everything after it need the TNT to blow the castle's blast door.

## Upgrading

Replace `timesplittersfp.apworld` in your Archipelago `custom_worlds` folder and restart the Launcher. The client updates your patched disc copy the next time it starts. Your original disc is never changed.

Games already in progress can update and keep playing. The logic changes only apply to newly generated seeds.
1.0.4.title: TSFP-AP v1.0.4
